objective: Investigate data quality, outcome selection, temporal shift and representativeness; evaluate controlled preprocessing/data ablations and SVM alongside previous families
primary_population: Accepted 36-month loans with terminal outcomes; 2015 has near-complete terminal coverage in this snapshot. No claims about rejected applicants or all active loans.
benchmark_compute_rule: All models share the same stratified seed-42 20000-row retrospective benchmark per year. Nonselected exact-RBF models use only this common sample because prediction of 40595 validation loans took 146-163 seconds per model. All other models, and always the preselected winner, additionally use the full benchmark cohort. Keep the two scopes in separate tables; never compare their AP directly.
svm_solver_repair: Before selection, retry failed RBF configurations with the same C/gamma/class weights and max_iter=100000 rather than 20000. Count and report these extra solver attempts separately; never use benchmark results for this repair.
selection_rule: Highest AP on the complete 2014 Q3 36-month cohort; no new ensemble search. Fixed previous-family comparators use the same selected input recipe and dates.
parameter_controls: CatBoost and LightGBM with the exact previous best parameters are eligible selection candidates alongside the newly tuned configurations, on identical training/validation rows.
availability_2013_controls: Before any new benchmark predictions, additionally compare 2013-onward training after the audit verified ~52% missing bureau fields in 2012 versus 0% in 2013. Fix previous parameters for CatBoost/LightGBM and current tuned parameters for the three SVM strategies. Same full Q3 validation cohort; these data variants are eligible. No new hyperparameter search is performed for them.
screening_rule: Use fixed previous LightGBM hyperparameters to compare one-factor and combined data/preprocessing recipes on the same two CV validation cohorts. Select the highest mean AP recipe before hyperparameter search.
calibration_rule: Fit sigmoid and isotonic on Oct-Nov 2014; select Brier then log-loss on Dec 2014. Preserve raw rank AP and AUC separately.
benchmark_role: 2015/2016 are reused, previously observed retrospective benchmarks, NOT pristine independent final tests. The original experiment and metrics remain immutable.
benchmark_primary: 2015 36-month IDs outside the initial 115000 sample and schema-preview IDs, exactly matching the previous mature sensitivity cohort
benchmark_secondary: 2016 36-month terminal outcomes as censored temporal stress. Original mixed-term results are contextual only and are not compared to the new within-36-month AP.
mature_secondary_rule: Separately evaluate 2016 36-month issue months with source terminal coverage >= 99.5%; choose months by coverage only, never AP. These remain reused benchmarks.
additional_information_sensitivity: Diagnostic only: add LC grade/sub_grade/int_rate after the platform has assigned them. This changes information scope and is not eligible for the independent pre-pricing model selection.
limits: No reliable historical charge-off event date: retrospective vintage separation is not an as-of-production backtest.
2017 and 2018 do not provide complete loan follow-up; conditioning on terminal outcomes cannot manufacture mature independent validation.
All imputers, encoders, clipping limits and available-column selections are fitted on training only.
The exact RBF SVM has a smaller explicit training budget. A matched-budget comparison will distinguish computational budget from algorithm effects.
No target labels are assigned to active loans. Bounds and selection diagnostics do not identify their eventual outcomes.
Bootstrap intervals on reused benchmarks quantify conditional paired sampling variation; they do not undo adaptive reuse of the benchmark.
